events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury was born Farrokh Bulsara on September 5, 1946, in Stone Town, Zanzibar.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Eighty years since his birth, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain iconic. What's your favourite Queen track or solo moment?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' lead vocalist, guitarist, and primary songwriter, Chrissie Hynde, was born on September 7, 1951, in Akron, Ohio.

angles.name: Rock Icon Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting have powered The Pretenders for decades. What's your top track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher, best known as the lead singer of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972, in Manchester.

angles.name: Mad for Liam
angles.copy: Fifty-four years young today! Liam Gallagher, the unmistakable voice of Oasis, continues to deliver rock'n'roll attitude. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: Imagine... 51 years since John Lennon's iconic album
events.blurb: John Lennon's second solo studio album, 'Imagine', co-produced with Yoko Ono and Phil Spector, was released on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK, with the single released on October 11, 1971, in the US.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine' – a song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity. What does it mean to you?

events.title: The iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 25 years since the original iPod dropped? The device that changed how we listen to music forever. What was your first iPod?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the 1962 premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Grab a martini (shaken, not stirred!) – it's James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since Dr. No. Who's your favourite 007 and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: English musician, songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939, in Weston-super-Mare, Somerset, England.

angles.name: Comedy Legend John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs. What's your favourite sketch or role?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album: 58 years young
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. A double album of incredible diversity. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: Queen's iconic lead singer Freddie Mercury died on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45, due to complications from AIDS.

angles.name: Freddie's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His legacy of electrifying performances and timeless music lives on. What's your favourite memory of Freddie?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul: 61 years of innovation
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released in the United Kingdom on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles pushed boundaries with 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a significant artistic evolution. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: English musician John Lennon, formerly of The Beatles, was fatally shot on December 8, 1980, outside his residence in Manhattan, New York City.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His vision for peace and his timeless music continue to resonate. What does his legacy mean to you?
